title: partnerships-marketplace-daily-notes-jordan-5
content:
Daily scratchpad - partnerships / marketplace (quick log, todo, reminders)

Date: 2026-03-04
Owner: Jordan Patel
Context: prep and follow-ups for Partner X integration + marketplace listing. Quick personal log for things to track + who to ping.

Top priorities:
- Finalize Partner X onboarding checklist (docs + tech) -> need legal input on revenue share clause before we send contract. (ask Ashley)
- Confirm sandbox API keys + webhook signing for Partner X. Devs need keys by EOD Wed.
- Marketplace listing draft due Fri (short one-pager + 3 screenshots).

Meeting notes (sync with Partner X, 2026-03-04 10:00am):
- Partners want 99th p50 latency guarantee for dedicated offering; we clarified Dedicated vs Hosted SLAs. They will start on Hosted and move to Dedicated in Q3.
- Integration approach: server-to-server API with webhook callbacks for async job completion. They prefer HMAC signing.
- Data privacy: they asked about logs retention — explained we can set retention per-customer in Private and Dedicated.
- Action items from partner: provide sandbox keys, sample payloads, and expected throughput (QPS) by next Tue.

Action items (personal TODOs):
- [ ] Send Partner X sandbox onboarding packet (include: API docs link, example requests, rate limits, webhook signing guide). OWNER: Jordan. DUE: 2026-03-05
- [ ] Create quick checklist for infra team: expected QPS, max tokens, retry strategy, webhook retry policy. OWNER: Samir. DUE: 2026-03-06
- [ ] Ask Ashley to review revenue share term and attach redline. OWNER: Jordan -> Ashley. DUE: 2026-03-05
- [ ] Draft marketplace listing copy + gather 3 screenshots (console flows). OWNER: Jordan. DUE: 2026-03-06
- [ ] Open PR for sample integration tests + add Partner X to nightly integration matrix. OWNER: Eng (assign to Priya). DUE: 2026-03-10

Integration checklist (tech quick checklist - scratch):
- API access
  - Create sandbox API key (scoped: read/write for sandbox)
  - Confirm token expiration & rotation cadence
  - Document rate limits (initially 20 QPS, can increase)
- Webhooks
  - Implement HMAC signing using shared secret (sha256)
  - Retry/backoff policy: exponential, 5 retries over 24 hours
  - Delivery diagnostics: include request-id + timestamp in callback payloads
- Data handling
  - Ensure no PII in logs by default; opt-in for debug logs with customer consent
  - Retention: 30 days default for hosted sandbox; configurable for Dedicated/Private
- Testing
  - Provide sample payloads and expected responses (happy path + errors)
  - Add integration tests to CI (mock partner endpoints + simulate retries)
- Security/compliance
  - SSO/SAML for partner admin console? (TBD)
  - Contract clause: SOC2 + DPA included (ask Legal)

Blockers / Open questions:
- Legal needs to approve revenue share language before sending contract (blocking onboarding doc).
- Need confirmation on throughput numbers — partner said 1k QPS burst in worst case; engineering to validate feasibility for Hosted vs Dedicated.
- Who owns production support escalation for first 30 days post-launch? Recommend rotating on-call between Partner Solutions and SRE.

Quick links + refs:
- Confluence draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PM/partner-x-integration
- Jira epic: PMKT-412
- Sandbox API docs: https://api.redwood.ai/docs/sandbox (shareable)

Notes to self / next steps:
- Ping Ashley in the afternoon for legal redline.
- Draft the Marketplace one-pager skeleton now (title, blurb, 3 bullets on benefits, CTA).
- Add FAQ section to listing: "what infra is required?" "how do we handle scaling?"

Random / quick fragments (brainstorm):
- Promo idea: give 3-month reduced fee for first 10 partners who list on marketplace (check with finance).
- Could include a "Verified performance" badge if partner passes smoke tests (latency + throughput).

End of notes.
